description: The image displays a conceptual pie chart divided into four equal quadrants, each representing a distinct dimension of a benchmarking framework for large language models (LLMs) in the context of NP (Nondeterministic Polynomial-time) problems. The top-left quadrant, colored mustard yellow, is labeled “Complexity” and associated with the term “Uncrushable,” accompanied by an icon of a ladder, suggesting hierarchical or escalating difficulty. The top-right quadrant, in muted blue-gray, is labeled “Instance” and paired with “Unhackable,” featuring a shield icon with a checkmark, implying robustness or security against manipulation. The bottom-left quadrant, in deep maroon, is labeled “Scalable Oversight” and linked to “Auto-verifiable,” with an icon of a checklist and checkmark, emphasizing automated validation and supervision at scale. The bottom-right quadrant, in olive green, is labeled “Coverage” and associated with “General,” illustrated with a gear and globe icon, indicating broad applicability and systemic reach. Each quadrant is visually anchored by a corresponding labeled callout box positioned outside the pie, reinforcing the conceptual mapping. The chart visually communicates a balanced, four-pillar framework for evaluating LLMs on NP-hard reasoning tasks, emphasizing uncrushability, unhackability, auto-verifiability, and general coverage — all critical for scalable and trustworthy AI reasoning systems.
